job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 25%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Response and Additional Evidence of Capability - 10%; 4. Competitiveness & Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: Accept faithful shorter criterion names with correct mapping 25/40/10/25. Supporting subcriteria are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Rice University RFP for retirement-plan audit services, not the TMRS global custody RFP. Its evaluation criteria have no percentage weights and do not support the requested criteria.
quotes: Request for Proposal to Provide Audit Services for the William Marsh Rice University Defined Contribution Retirement Plan
The selection process will include the following criteria in the evaluation of proposals.
• Qualifications and experience with similar institutions • Ability to meet scope and deliverable requirements • Pricing • Diversity in team structure • Requirements met as stated in proposal
